    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite nonnegative")
    for arr in [logp_with_result, logp_call_only, logp_no_call]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError("each logp input must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError("each logp input must be a 2D matrix")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError("each logp input must be nonempty")
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
            raise ValueError("logp inputs must be finite")
        if np.any(arr > 0):
            raise ValueError("logp inputs must be nonpositive")
    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("all logp inputs must have the same shape")

    n, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    raw = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * np.arange(horizon))
    norm_weights = raw / raw.sum()

    L_plus = -np.sum(logp_with_result * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_call_only = -np.sum(logp_call_only * norm_weights, axis=1)
    L_no_call = -np.sum(logp_no_call * norm_weights, axis=1)

    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)
    margins = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margins >= tau_filter

    return keep, margins"}
